```{r}
setwd("D:/HLHS/2024 final version/10 global mapping/1 mouse pab human genes/")
```


```{r}
mpab <- readRDS("D:/HLHS/2024 final version/4 mouse pab clean global object/mousepab_global_cleaned.rds")
DimPlot(mpab, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, group.by = "global.type", split.by = "condition")
```



```{r}
exp_mtx <- as.matrix(mpab@assays$SCT@data)
```

```{r}
dim(exp_mtx)
```

```{r}
mouse <- as.data.frame(row.names(exp_mtx))
write.table(mouse, file="mousenames.tsv", sep="\t", quote=F, col.names=NA)
```

#gene names converted with https://biit.cs.ut.ee/gprofiler/orth
```{r}
convert <- read.csv2("D:/HLHS/2024 final version/10 global mapping/1 mouse pab human genes/gProfiler_mmusculus_hsapiens_6-24-2024_1-32-10 PM.csv", sep = ",", header = T, quote = "\"")

convert <- convert[!duplicated(convert$g.),]

mouse$human <- convert$ortholog_name

colnames(mouse) <- c("mouse", "human")
```

```{r}
dim(exp_mtx)
```


```{r}

leftbehind <- mouse[mouse$human == "N/A",]
leftbehind <- as.data.frame(leftbehind)
#genes not converted are largely non coding, but also mhc, zfp, others
dim(leftbehind)
```

```{r}
mouse <- mouse[mouse$human != "N/A",]
mouse <- mouse[mouse$human != "",]
dim(mouse)
```

```{r}
mouse <- mouse[!duplicated(mouse$mouse),]
dim(mouse)
```

```{r}
mouse <- mouse[!duplicated(mouse$human),]
dim(mouse)
```

```{r}
exp_mtx <-subset(exp_mtx, rownames(exp_mtx) %in% mouse$mouse)
```

```{r}
dim(exp_mtx)
```




```{r}
exp_mtx <- exp_mtx[ order(row.names(exp_mtx)), ]
before <- rownames(exp_mtx)
```

```{r}
mouse <- mouse[ order(mouse$mouse),]
```



```{r}

rownames(exp_mtx) <- mouse$human
after <- rownames(exp_mtx)
```

```{r}
tail(before)
tail(after)
```




```{r}
humangenes_mpab <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = exp_mtx, meta.data = mpab@meta.data )
```

```{r}
humangenes_mpab[["umap"]] <- mpab[["umap"]]
```


```{r}
figure <- ggarrange(a1, a2, a3, a4, a5, a6, a7, a8, a9, a10, a11, a12, a13, a14, a15, a16, a17, a18, a19, a20, a21, a22, a23, a24,
```
